The provisional main selection list and the provisional additional lists have been published with reference to the direct recruitment notifications dated November 15, 2025, issued by the Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB).
The Board has stated that all information related to the lists can be viewed on the website: www.bwssb.gov.in
